notes.title: My New Game “Monster Mayhem” Launches June 27!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

I’m super excited to announce that my next game, Monster Mayhem, will be launching on June 27 on Steam!

I’ve been working solo on this project for a while now, and if you’ve enjoyed any of my previous games, I think you’ll really enjoy this one too. Monster Mayhem is a fast-paced 2D survivors like game where you fight through waves of monsters, unlock unique heroes, and take down huge bosses – all wrapped in a colorful, cartoonish style.

If you’d like to support a solo dev, the best way is to wishlist the game, it helps a lot with visibility on launch day:
---> https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585220/Monster_Mayhem/

Thanks so much for all the support, it means the world to me. See you June 27!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1] Added Full Gamepad support [/h1]
Now you can play the entire game with the xbox 360/one gamepad.
Press H on the keyboard or LB to turn the gamepad on/off.

[h1] New features [/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to reset the cities already conquered, so you can conquer them again.
[*]Now some bushes, once destroyed, drop some fruit that can be eaten to recover life.
[/list]

[h1] Changes [/h1]
The key to skip dialogues is now "Enter" on the keyboard and "A" on the gamepad.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed problem for which weapons were not spawned once barrels and crates were destroyed.
[*]Fixed problem that in some cases prevented returning to the main menu.
[*]Fixed various collision problems.
[*]When the ship is destroyed, it now reappears at the port of the last island visited.
[*]Fixed various problems concerning some enemies.
[/list]
